scientific_question: How much information do sparse positive occurrence anchors contain about reachability worlds beyond local viability alone, and how does that information depend on the spatial arrangement of the observed occurrences?

latent_landscapes.reuse: exact v2 7x7 generators, factor levels, seeds, A/B permissibility, geographic graphs and edge-uniform barrier draws
latent_landscapes.truth_world: relative_edge_q70 at the v2 row's own barrier-density level and the original v2 truth source

candidate_world_universe_per_latent_land.sources: every A/B-permissive node is admitted as a candidate source; truth source is not revealed by the occurrence evidence
candidate_world_universe_per_latent_land.cartesian_product: candidate source x barrier level x analyst rule
candidate_world_universe_per_latent_land.A_and_B: shared latent permissibility field across candidate worlds
candidate_world_universe_per_latent_land.world_compatibility: every observed positive anchor must be reachable from the candidate source under that candidate barrier/rule world

observation_contract.truth_positive_pool: all non-source nodes reachable in the frozen truth world
observation_contract.eligibility: truth positive pool must contain at least four non-source nodes; otherwise the row is non-estimable and retained as such
observation_contract.anchor_count_rule: max(1, ceil(fraction * truth_positive_pool_size)); counts are identical across sampling designs within a row/fraction

sampling_designs.clustered_near_source: order truth-positive nodes by truth-world BFS depth, then Euclidean distance to truth source, then node ID
sampling_designs.dispersed_farthest_first: first choose the truth-positive node farthest in Euclidean distance from truth source; then greedily choose the node maximizing its minimum Euclidean distance to already chosen anchors; ties by node ID

comparison.local_viability_only: because every truth-positive anchor is A/B-permissive and candidate worlds share A/B, local-only evidence retains the complete candidate source x barrier x analyst universe
comparison.reachability_aware: retain only candidate worlds in which every observed positive anchor is reachable from that world's candidate source

primary_outputs: survivor-world count and fraction by coverage and sampling design
robustly unreachable locally-permissive nodes across the surviving world set

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For both sampling designs, pooled mean survivor-world fraction under reachability-aware conditioning is <1 at every nonzero coverage level.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any design/coverage level whose pooled mean survivor fraction is not <1.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Within every eligible row and sampling design, survivor-world count is nonincreasing as the nested positive-anchor set grows.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At equal anchor counts, at least one eligible row has different survivor-world counts under clustered and dispersed sampling.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if spatial arrangement never changes survivor contraction.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At 25% and 50% coverage, pooled mean survivor-world fraction is lower for dispersed-farthest-first anchors than for clustered-near-source anchors.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately at either coverage if the dispersed-minus-clustered contrast is >=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For each sampling design, pooled mean robust-impossibility recovery fraction is nondecreasing with coverage and is strictly larger at full coverage than at 10% coverage.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any design if monotonicity fails or the endpoint contrast is nonpositive.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: No truth-reachable locally-permissive node is ever classified robustly unreachable across the surviving candidate worlds.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any false robust exclusion is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across eligible rows under full positive coverage, median surviving candidate-world count is >1 and median surviving candidate-source count is >1 for at least one of the two sampling designs.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if full positive coverage typically collapses both world and source identity to singletons under both designs.

secondary_outputs: fraction of rows with exact truth-world recovery
survivor contraction attributable to source, barrier or analyst-rule elimination
relationship between truth reachable-component size and survivor contraction
relationship between route redundancy and occurrence information content
claim_boundary: Occurrence-information frequencies are properties of the frozen synthetic generator and candidate-world family.
Candidate-source contraction is not ancestry inference.
Robustly unreachable means unreachable in every surviving declared world, not universally impossible in nature.
The dispersed versus clustered comparison is a synthetic survey-information experiment, not a field sampling recommendation without external cost and detectability models.
stop_rules: Do not change coverage fractions after scoring.
Do not change candidate source, barrier or analyst-rule universe after scoring.
Do not add another sampling design to rescue O4.
Do not tune the minimum eligible positive-pool size after scoring.
